description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using various speech and language processing services, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and large language models, with integrations for GitHub MCP and WebRTC transport.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the context with user parameters and strategies.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns for smart turn-taking.

classes.name: GoogleLLMService
classes.description: Large language model service from Google.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts processing.
